title: Split correlation as an averaged convolution
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and suppose a linear coordinate isomorphism identifies $H\times\mathbb F_2^d$ with $\mathbb F_2^n$ and sends $(h,0)$ to $h$. For any $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{\pm1\}$, its split character correlation equals $\mathbb E_a\bigl[A(a)(g*g)(a)\bigr]$, where $A(a)=\mathbb E_{h\in H} f(h,a)$ in these coordinates, $g(b)=f(0,b)$, and convolution is normalized additive convolution on $\mathbb F_2^d$.
hypotheses_covered: A linear coordinate isomorphism $H\times\mathbb F_2^d\simeq\mathbb F_2^n$ is specified
The isomorphism sends $(h,0)$ to $h$ for every $h\in H$
